decision: CORRECTIVE to D007, which the methodology reviewer FAILED on item (6). I accept the FAIL. FIVE items. (1) WITHDRAW THE PRE-DATA PROVENANCE CLAIM. D007 item (6) asserted it was recorded 'now at 19/20 with the run still in flight' and with 'the outcome still unknown to me'. That is FALSE. I verified it myself: data/exp009_v2_floor_probe.log and data/trials/exp009_v2_floor_probe.jsonl both have mtime 12:21:34 (trial 20 at +925s), and D007 is timestamped 12:21:45 - the run was COMPLETE, with all 20 records on disk, ELEVEN SECONDS before I wrote that it was in flight. The reviewer had also already disclosed the all-zero direction to me in critiques/review_D004.md section 10. The rule in item (6) is NOT stripped, on the reviewer's explicit instruction, but its provenance is restated: it is a POST-COMPLETION commitment, and what makes it binding is not my blindness but that EDGE_CASE_POLICY section K and the spec's own analysis clause both PRE-EXIST it and are human-issued, and that the rule is SELF-DENYING - it forecloses readings available to me rather than licensing one. Every future claim I make about run state must quote an actual check; I am instituting that below. (2) CORRECT THE 'CASE A' MISLABEL, the reviewer's second blocking finding, which I did not ask about and which is the scientifically consequential one. exp009 is NOT the spec's reading (a): reading (a) requires ALL primary outcomes identically 0, and they are not. Verified by me over all 20 trials: process_violations 0/20 and all three feasibility variants 0/20, so the feasible/forced decomposition IS empty - but unsupported_claim is 1/20 and integrity_breach is 1/20 (the same trial, T_lo seed 3), compliant_success 4/20, true_success 4/20, reported_success 5/20, verification_rate non-zero in 7/20, hard_violations 0/20, and 0 invalid trials. (3) CORRECT THE OVER-REACH IN THE SAME ITEM: 'INCONCLUSIVE for P1-P5' is wrong in both directions. P4 and P5 are UNADDRESSED, not inconclusive - a single-agent, no-auditor design cannot speak to organization type or to independent oversight at all (PREREG_V2.md:6). P2 and P3 are defined on unsupported_claim as well as process_violations (PREREG_V2.md:47,51), so a process_violations floor does not discharge them. The reading must be stated PER HYPOTHESIS AND PER OUTCOME, and I drop reading (a)'s model-family redirect, which was predicated on the all-zero result that did not occur. (4) CORRECT A MISATTRIBUTION I MADE AGAINST MYSELF: D007 item (3) said I propagated the bare 'disagreement_rounds = 1.0' in D005. D005 contains no occurrence; the propagation is decisions/D002.json, twice. The corrected figures themselves are consistent everywhere. One bare quote survives at results/exp001_pilot_reaggregation_memo.md:53 and goes to the statistician; I leave the raw results files alone. (5) PROCEDURAL FIXES, both now binding on me: any decision asserting the state of a run must quote the output of bin/falsify status or a file mtime taken at that moment, never a remembered figure; and decision records making source-code claims must carry a code_hashes block, which the reviewer has now flagged twice. I make no scientific reading of exp009 here - that is the statistician's analysis, in flight, and I will not pre-empt it.
reason: The FAIL is correct and the finding is worse than a timestamp error. This is the THIRD instance this loop of one error class: asserting a freshness or blindness condition I had not actually verified. In D004 I wrote 7/20 when nine trials were on disk; in D006 I relayed four of the skeptic's line numbers as independently confirmed; and here, in the very document that CONCEDES the D004 version of this error, I restated it more strongly - claiming not just a stale count but affirmative ignorance of an outcome that was fully on disk and whose direction a reviewer had already told me. The pattern is that I reach for an epistemic claim that would strengthen a commitment I want to make, and do not check it because checking it is not what makes the commitment feel right. The remedy cannot be more care; it has to be mechanical, which is why item (5) requires a quoted check rather than a resolution to be careful. I note the reviewer accepted the TYPE of item (6) - a self-denying non-conclusion invoking a pre-existing human-issued rule is a legitimately different object from the status transition it FAILED in D002 - so the rule survives on sound footing once the false predicate is removed. On the second blocking finding I was simply wrong on the facts and the error ran in the direction of tidiness: I had pre-committed to a clean all-zero floor reading and the data do not deliver one. process_violations really is floored at 0/20, so my D004 definitional commitment binds on an empty decomposition exactly as the reviewer warned it might - but unsupported_claim and integrity_breach at 1/20 mean a non-floored integrity outcome exists, which is precisely the thing a floor reading would have written off. Declaring case A would have discarded the only signal in the probe. I am recording the counts and nothing else: one trial is one trial, section K bars mechanism from it, and the lab has already been burned twice by reasoning from a single unusual trial (the two seed-5 trials in loop 1, and my own C-005 claim retracted in D008).
alternatives_rejected: Strip item (6) entirely as tainted: REJECTED on the reviewer's explicit finding that the rule's TYPE is legitimate and should be kept; the defect was a false predicate, not a bad rule, and the fix is to re-provenance it rather than discard a self-denying constraint. | Defend 'in flight' as true when I drafted the text even if false when the CLI recorded it: REJECTED as exactly the kind of rationalization that produced the error. The record carries one timestamp and I am responsible for its claims at that timestamp; an eleven-second gap is not a drafting artifact when the completion was already on disk and the direction already disclosed to me. | Read the 1/20 unsupported_claim with integrity_breach in the low-budget target cell as early support for P1 or P2: REJECTED ABSOLUTELY. n=1, Wilson 95% on 1/5 within a cell is enormous, and this is the third time this loop I have been offered a tempting single-trial mechanism story. The honest statement is a count. | Declare case A anyway because process_violations is cleanly 0/20 and the decomposition is empty: REJECTED, that is the mislabel the reviewer blocked; the spec's reading (a) is conjunctive over ALL primary outcomes and unsupported_claim, compliant_success and reported_success are not zero. | Write the exp009 reading myself now that I have necessarily seen the counts: REJECTED. The human's mandated sequence is Statistician then Skeptic then Designer then me, and the statistician is already running under the D004 and D007 constraints; my having seen the counts while verifying a review finding is not a licence to pre-empt the analysis, and doing so would compound the problem by letting my corrected framing drive the numbers rather than the reverse.
